description: This file defines functions and constants for creating and managing agent tools in the openclaw project, including policy application, tool normalization, and tool creation with sandboxing and policy enforcement.

methods.name: isOpenAIProvider
methods.description: Checks if the given provider string corresponds to an OpenAI provider.

methods.name: normalizeMessageProvider
methods.description: Normalizes the message provider string to lowercase trimmed form.

methods.name: applyMessageProviderToolPolicy
methods.description: Filters tools based on message provider allow/deny lists.

methods.name: applyModelProviderToolPolicy
methods.description: Filters tools based on model provider policies, e.g., suppressing web_search for certain providers.

methods.name: applyDeferredFollowupToolDescriptions
methods.description: Adds descriptions to 'exec' and 'process' tools based on whether cron is present.

methods.name: isApplyPatchAllowedForModel
methods.description: Determines if applyPatch is allowed for a given model based on allowModels list.

methods.name: resolveExecConfig
methods.description: Resolves execution configuration parameters, merging global and agent-specific settings.

methods.name: resolveToolLoopDetectionConfig
methods.description: Resolves loop detection configuration for tools based on global and agent-specific settings.

methods.name: createOpenClawCodingTools
methods.description: Main function to create a list of agent tools with sandboxing, policy enforcement, and configuration based on provided options.
